calls.title: Mark P Beltran and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The executive team discussed enhancing financial management and accountability by implementing departmental P&L reporting, aiming for 18 months of cash in the bank by year-end. Mark and Ashley emphasized the importance of a simple initial forecast to initiate budgeting discussions. Additionally, they highlighted the significance of accurate billing and ARR integrity to prepare for future growth, noting discrepancies in internal reports. Monthly financial reviews and a centralized hiring tracking spreadsheet were proposed to improve decision-making. The board's strategy is to pivot towards high-value customers and innovative pricing models to drive significant growth beyond 2026, while also addressing billing bugs that could recover substantial revenue.
calls.keywords: Cash flow, Profit & Loss, Hiring plan, Billing reconciliation, AI product strategy, Pricing model
calls.action_items:
**Mark Beltran**
Create a departmental Profit & Loss statement from QuickBooks data using Fondo tagging and existing transaction categorization to improve financial visibility by department (03:35)
Develop and circulate a simple centralized hiring spreadsheet tracking currently active recruitments including approval status, proposed start dates, and salary information to improve hiring transparency and control (17:46)
Coordinate iterative forecast (version 1) development involving Ashley, Ryan, Graham, and Jeremy to align on top-line projections and spending management (15:18)
Schedule and attend monthly executive meetings to review past month’s financial performance and next month’s forecast, with optional interim input meetings as needed (19:36)
Communicate progress and questions with Ashley, maintaining direct channels and possibly group Slack for broader executive updates to ensure timely collaboration and information flow (22:07)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide access and guidance on QuickBooks data and insights to assist Mark with P&L and financial categorization efforts (16:11)
Manage hiring process transparency by compiling active hiring needs and approvals into the centralized spreadsheet to support Mark's tracking efforts (17:27)
Help facilitate communication and coordination with Jeremy, Graham, and Ryan regarding financial forecasts and hiring plans to ensure alignment among key leaders (21:47)
Oversee progress on billing reconciliation work with Charlie, supporting prioritization of issues and validation of revenue capture to improve billing accuracy and revenue recognition (21:01)
Maintain Slack channel or other communication methods preferred by the executive team for quick updates and collaboration to enhance communication efficiency (22:01)
